body.message:
A refundable security deposit of AED 2,000 is required upon check-in.

Please note that the security deposit will be refunded within 14 working days after check-out, subject to a satisfactory inspection of the apartment. The refund will be processed via credit card or bank transfer.

Our standard check-in time is between 3:00 PM and 9:00 PM. If the apartment is ready earlier, we will be happy to accommodate an early check-in, subject to availability. For arrivals after 9:00 PM, self-check-in will be arranged.

We would also like to kindly clarify that, unlike hotels, our holiday homes at fäm Living are located in residential buildings and communities. The properties are offered for short-term stays through fäm Living, and therefore, hotel-style services such as daily housekeeping, breakfast, or a reception desk are not provided.

For more information and photos of the apartment at Ahad Residences, please find our Airbnb listing below:

Ahad Residences – 1 Bedroom : https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/1777367336092186517

Please let us know if you would like to proceed, and we will be happy to assist you with the booking process.
